latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the arming-thought skill.
- Establishes "seeking truth from facts" as the overarching principle at the start of conversations.
- Outlines a structured methodology inspired by Mao Zedong Thought, including philosophy, work methods, and strategy.
- Provides clear mapping between situations and required downstream skills.
- Emphasizes user-centeredness, responsibility, perseverance, and strict priority hierarchy.
